title: First-visit consultation confirmation goes straight to availability
description: The caller asks for the nearest available slot without first-visit status, then confirms that this is the first visit and adds that it is for a consultation. The assistant should treat consultation as the default first-visit path, call checkAvailability immediately, and avoid collecting identity before any slot is chosen.
